instruction.text: Move towards the sliding door which is infront of you, go through the sliding door and move forward, to the left you can find steps, move forward, to the left you can find an oven, move forward until you see an opening to your left, turn left and move towards the bedroom which is infront of you, now you are at the entrance of the bedroom, slightly turn to your right and move a bit forward, where to the right you can find a sliding door, that would be your end point.
